location: D-E, L11 [Herbert: L11, 1.12.7]; ex church at Sebnitz, near Dresden. Presented by the weaver’s guild in Sebnitz to the local church, 1725. Played in the Sebnitz church through the end of the 19th cen.  Herbert: On loan from Heimatmuseum, Sebnitz—same for others by Müller]
signature: : "Macht Iohann Myller in Alt Dresden Anno 1725"; mark of the weaver’s guild?: circle containing three leaves arranged in triangle, with ear of corn in middle of each leaf; six-pointed star in center of triangle;¹ "Diese Posaunen hat zu Christi milden Angedencken. Eine werethe Weber Zunft Gottes Tempel wollen schencken Gott zv Ehren thaten sie auf die volthuns volle Hand, Der erhalte sie davor stets in FLORISANTEN stand"; "Zum Andencken schriebs C. G. Heintze / Cantor zu Sebnitz den 19. May".
dimensions: le 3506 (3541 - 35),**** bo 12.1 mm, be 129.5, bore 75% cylindrical, 25% conical/hyperbolic.
remarks: 7 pos.; bell end at 3rd pos. Round slide-stays, moveable stay telescopic****; iron handle, with wooden grip, attached to moveable slide stay. Keine Manschetten****. Saxon-style rim-wire.
